name: Divider
description: A visual separator that divides content either horizontally or vertically. Supports an optional inline label that appears centred between two lines.

notes: aria-orientation is set to match the orientation prop.
When a label is present, the separator is wrapped in a div and the line is purely presentational.

orientation.description: Orientation of the divider. Horizontal renders a full-width rule; vertical renders an inline rule.

label.description: Optional text label displayed at the centre of the divider. Only supported for horizontal orientation.

className.description: Additional CSS class names to apply to the root element.

do: Use horizontal dividers to separate sections of content.
Use vertical dividers to separate inline items like toolbar actions.
Keep labels very short — one to three words.
dont: Do not use a label on a vertical divider.
Do not use the divider as a layout primitive — use spacing tokens instead.
Do not nest interactive content inside a divider.
